The hosts and other staff were very nice. Our waiter on the other hand was super grumpy and seemed like he either hated us or his job. As soon as I sat down with the hostess, he came over and in front of me scolded her for  it removing the extra cutlery. I felt so embarrassed for her. Throughout our time there he didn’t engage with us, didn’t smile, and barely spoke or checked in on us. I watched other severs interact with their tables and I was jealous of their experience. He was a bit older than the other staff so maybe thought he was above them? He literally made us feel like a burden. We didn’t ask for anything t special, didn’t need to ask him for anything - we were such an easy table. Not sure what his deal was. Review Comments: We've been here before with very positive experiences (the Maiale pizza is amazing) but the latest was a bit disappointing with one major dish. I decided to order the spaghetti carbonara - the presentation was beautiful, the beef tenderloin was cooked perfectly, but the pasta was under sauced and quite dry; the pasta was perfectly cooked, but I would have no idea that it was sauced with a lemon cream sauce if the menu didn't say so. In hindsight I should have asked for another side of sauce (my mother's and brother's pastas had much more sauce, they didn't have the carbonara; the waiter had brought us the wrong beer initially and I sent it back and felt a bit bad so I didn't want to rock the boat). It's not a big deal, but when you spend $300 for a nice Italian meal (and almost $50 for a pasta dish) and we were visiting in from out of province, you would hope details such as these for a high end Italian restaurant would be a non-issue. My wife's caprese salad looked great and my daughter's salami pizza was also delicious. I probably should have just ordered a different dish. The experience was great, but the carbonara was a little bit, meh. Otherwise, great ambience, service, well coordinated, food hot, fresh and fast. I just left feeling a little bit disappointed ultimately with a tasty but dry pasta dish and not sure if we'll come back when we're in town next.

Review Comments:
Il Terrazzo has long been one of Victoria's landmark restaurants, and after our latest dinner I was reminded why it continues to rank among the city's very best. Tucked away in historic Waddington Alley, it feels like you've stepped into a hidden Italian courtyard. The candlelight, exposed brick, fireplaces, lush greenery and intimate atmosphere create one of the most beautiful dining rooms in British Columbia. It is elegant without being pretentious and romantic without feeling overdone.

The first thing we noticed was the new menu design. It is a fantastic update that feels fresh, modern and much easier to read while still respecting the restaurant's classic identity.

Every dish was exceptional. The Fusilli con Sugo di Manzo featured a rich, slow-cooked bolognese with cream, mozzarella, parmesan, spinach and basil that delivered incredible depth of flavour without feeling heavy. The Lamb Shank was beautifully braised, incredibly tender and complemented perfectly by red wine, rosemary, olives, artichokes and sun-dried tomatoes.

The Marco Polo continues to deserve its reputation as one of Il Terrazzo's signature dishes. The combination of chicken, toasted cashews, mango, basil and creamy lemon sauce is unique, perfectly balanced and absolutely unforgettable.

What truly made the evening was our server, Glen. His service was simply best in class. Professional, knowledgeable, attentive and genuinely personable, he anticipated every need without ever hovering. Hospitality like this is becoming rare, and Glen delivered one of the finest dining experiences we've had in years.

The wine list is equally impressive, featuring outstanding selections from the Okanagan, California and Italy that complement the menu beautifully.

Restaurants can have great food or great service. The very best deliver both while creating an atmosphere that makes you want to stay all evening. Il Terrazzo accomplishes exactly that. It remains one of the finest restaurants on Vancouver Island, and we will absolutely be back.

Thank you, Alex, Glen, and the entire team for another unforgettable evening.

Derek Sanderson

Derek Sanderson

Review Comments: This first rate restaurant, certainly one of the best in Victoria, has been here for many years and many of the employees have also been with them for long times.  It's a very attractive place, quite large.  The wait staff is professional and cordial.  My dinner last night was the best I have ever had in an Italian restaurant.  Fortunately we had a reservation.  Even for a Monday night it was full.  We had a Marco Polo pasta, cannelloni, caprese salad and a bread refill with taponade.  Our total was C$ 87 plus tax and tip.  Notice:  we had no drinks or dessert which can make a huge difference.  We're going back there next week.   Dry highly recommended (and I rarely give a five star rating).

the food and service was exceptional. at 6:00pm the restaurant was totally full. the portions are large and delicious. even in a crowded restaurant, our server was attentive but never intrusive. the restaurant itself is large but cozy with rustic styling and at home feeling.

Disappointing - We visited quite a few restaurants during our 4 days in Victoria, and this was the only disappointment. My wife ordered a chicken dinner that included prawn chunks, and it was not edible. The meat was kind of tough, and she thought there was something off with the taste. I tried it too, and had to agree. She did not eat it, and the waiter removed it from our bill. The 2 appetizers and my meal were good, but nothing that I would come back for again. The guy who brought our appetizers tried bringing us the wrong order twice, and on the 3rd attempt he finally brought my calamari instead of a caprese salad.  The caprese salad still showed up on our bill, and the waiter apologized and removed that too. The waiter was doing his best. After talking to locals we were told that the ownership of the restaurant had changed recently, and our experience was apparently not unique. The place was busy and there was a lineup to get in, so I hope they get their issues figured out because it sounds like this place is a long time fixture in Victoria's restaurant scene. But they have lots of competition.

Yum - Visually awesome. Sat on backyard  garden patio which was lovely and comfy. Food was amazing. Very cheesy.  Go mozzarella!!  Pink sauce on pasta was great! Service was amazing! She was sweet and attentive and french Canadian  decent prices. Busy so go early   .

Fabulous best Italian meal ever - Excellent meal 5 star quality. The service and attention to detail from all the staff. From the lady who greeted us to the water waiter all very attentive. I forgot to take photos of the food we were so hungry. I would say the best Italian meal I’ve ever had fabulous this place deserves all the good reviews

Still Top Shelf - We came here 12 years ago and I found it to be more polished and tasty than before—- that’s hard to do. 

A line of people defined our initial experience but thankfully the reservations staff deftly handled our “no reservation” request to dine and 65 mins later we were comfortably seated at a beautiful covered back patio area. 

The table service, it has to be said, was flawless the entire evening from the initial welcome through dinner service to the end bill and receipt delivery. Details matter and this team did an excellent job. 

Now the best part, the food. Bread service started to build up our appetite. The Caesar salad was well dressed. It could have used a touch more salt from anchovy or other but that didn’t prevent me from cleaning the plate. My rack of lamb arrived warm on a large selection of vegetables and pea risotto. It was delicious. The lamb was cooked to medium, maybe parts medium-well. The sauce covered the overcooking mistake with sweet & umami notes. I finished my entire plate again. 

My dining guests all enjoyed their pasta with scallops and pork tenderloin. 

Well done!

Delicious food, incredibly attentive and kind staff - I went on the Taste of Victoria Guided Food and History Tour earlier in the day and was advised to get here early (i.e. before 5pm) if I didn’t have a reservation, and that I’d maybe get a seat at the bar if I was lucky.
I was *incredibly* lucky: the extremely charming maitre d‘ kindly offered me a table in the beautiful main dining room, where I was served by the friendly and knowledgeable Carson. 
The food here is delicious (warm focaccia and olive tapenade are served as a complimentary starter) and the portions are generous. But what really made the experience was the staff - everyone was so kind and attentive and friendly. Honestly, I’d almost recommend the restaurant for the service alone! 5 stars!

Big Disappointment - Disappointing! This was our first return to this restaurant since the change of ownership. This was an anniversary celebration and we were. anticipating another wonderful meal. 
My wife’s Carbonara was not anything close to what was served before, it lacked basic seasoning, lacked enough cream and Parmesan cheese, the beef tenderloin was sliced and had no resemblance to the ” seared.tenderloin that set the dish off on previous visits. I think she has had this dish over 15 times in the last few years.  Our waiter did offer to replace it but if as he suggested her disappointment “Might have been the result of a bad day in the kitchen” which did not offer hope for improvement. Our friends pork tenderloin was tough and over cooked and the veggies were undercooked . My lamb shank was cooked perfectly but the accompanying  beans and veggies looked like they were recooked as they were dry and sticking together. Our problems continued but enough said we were very disappointed after having visited this restaurant many many times but it will be a while before we try it again!

Hidden treasure in Victoria - Hidden down a quiet alley is the charming Italian restaurant Il Terrazzo.  Wonderful decor, extremely attentive service and superb Italian cuisine.  Many offerings are modern updates on classic dishes.  Had a wonderful anniversary dinner and will return the next time we are in Victoria.
